flags.why: This respectful description belongs to formal usage and needs a register label ([usage discussion](https://baomoi.com/chu-va-nghia-lao-va-lao-thanh-c47122989.epi)).
Lão trượng denotes a venerable elderly man, not specifically one's grandfather or an affectionate 'gramps' ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/lao-truong-tieng-anh-la-gi)).

The mountain sense is characteristic of North Central Vietnamese, so Northern incorrectly suggests northern dialect usage ([regional discussion](https://www.nguyenduyxuan.net/que-huong-dat-nuoc/ngu-nghia-mot-so-dia-danh-thuoc-truong-tu-vung-nui-non-o-nghe-an-3687.html)).

The Vietnamese fruit is canistel (Pouteria campechiana), whereas English lucuma names a different fruit ([university research](https://huib.hueuni.edu.vn/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/1.-BAO-CAO-TOM-TAT-HN-CNSH-2024-IN-19.9.2024-FULL-chinh.pdf)).
The common use for a substantial improvement in someone's material circumstances is missing ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/L%C3%AAn_%C4%91%E1%BB%9Di)).
flags.fix: Add: verb [colloquial] | to move up in the world; to become better off.

flags.why: Everyday Vietnamese also uses lí luận as a verb for arguing or offering justifications, often disapprovingly ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/L%C3%AD_lu%E1%BA%ADn)).
flags.fix: Add: verb [colloquial] | to argue; to argue one's case (often disapproving).

flags.why: Lính quýnh is characteristic of Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([linguistic discussion](https://vjol.info.vn/index.php/sphcm/article/download/14822/13318/)).
